title: shatter our thinking Question, Learn higher level of a “new world” every child who comes through our classroom door becomes our teacher recognize read
summary: shatter our thinking Question, Learn higher level of a “new world” every child who comes through our classroom door becomes our teacher recognize reading as good enough legitimate recognize each child Bring families build a sense of community Found #smalllpoem from #edu307
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
shatter our thinking
Question, Learn
higher level of a
“new world”

every child who comes through
our classroom door
becomes our teacher

recognize reading
as good enough
legitimate
recognize each child
Bring families
build a sense of community
